Engine.description_zh: 数据库类型，固定取值为polarx

EngineVersion.description_en: The database engine version. Default value: 2.0

ExpireDate.description_en: The expiration time. The format is yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.sss+0000 (UTC)

Expired.description_en:
Indicates whether the instance has expired. Valid values:
true: Expired.
false: Normal
Expired.description_zh:
是否过期：

true：过期；
false：正常

MemberName.description_en: The name of the member, which is the name of the PolarDB-X instance

Role.description_en:
The role of the node. Valid values:

master: The primary node.
standby: The secondary node
Role.description_zh:
节点角色，取值如下：

master：主节点
standby：备节点

GdnRole.description_en: The role in the global database network (GDN)

Id.description_en: The ID of the primary instance. If this parameter is not returned, the instance is a primary instance
Id.description_zh: 主实例的ID，如果没有返回此参数则表示该实例是主实例

KindCode.description_en: The database engine version of the instance DPI engine. This is an internal parameter
KindCode.description_zh: 实例引擎版本，内部参数

LatestMinorVersion.description_en: The latest kernel Milvus version supported by the instance
LatestMinorVersion.description_zh: 当前实例支持的最新内核版本

LockMode.description_en:
The lock mode of the instance. Valid values:
Unlock: Normal.
ManualLock: Manually locked.
LockByExpiration: Automatically locked due to expiration.
LockByRestoration: Automatically locked before a rollback.
LockByDiskQuota: Automatically locked due to full storage space.
LockReadInstanceByDiskQuota: Automatically locked due to full storage space of the read-only instance
LockMode.description_zh:
实例锁定模式：

Unlock：正常；
ManualLock：手动触发锁定；
LockByExpiration：实例过期自动锁定；
LockByRestoration：实例回滚前的自动锁定；
LockByDiskQuota：实例空间满自动锁定；
LockReadInstanceByDiskQuota：只读实例空间满自动锁定

MaintainEndTime.description_en: The end time of the maintenance window for the instance. The time is in UTC. Add 8 hours to obtain the maintenance window displayed in the console
MaintainEndTime.description_zh: 实例可维护结束时间，此处为UTC时间，加8小时为控制台上显示的可维护时间段

MaintainStartTime.description_en: The start time of the maintenance window for the instance. The time is in UTC. Add 8 hours to obtain the maintenance window displayed in the console
MaintainStartTime.description_zh: 实例可维护开始时间，此处为UTC时间，加8小时才是控制台上显示的可维护时间段

Network.description_en: The network type of the instance. Only VPC is supported, which indicates a virtual private cloud
Network.description_zh: 实例的网络类型，仅支持取值VPC，表示专有网络

PayType.description_en:
The billing method of the instance. Valid values:
Postpaid: Pay-as-you-go.
Prepaid: Subscription
PayType.description_zh:
实例付费方式，取值：

Postpaid：按量付费；
Prepaid：包年包月

true: Enabled

三权分立状态：

disabled：未开启；
enabled：开启；
processing： 处理中；
unknown：未知，可能是实例无法连接导致
